# TUNING — Assignment 6

All strips are **fixture captures**. Each is a preview scene rendered by Movie Maker at 30 fps, with a fixed seed set on the preview's own instance only. Setup: Godot 4.7.2, Forward+, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU, 1280 × 720.

Each revision below records five things:
- what I saw in the running game;
- Claude's reading of the strip before the change;
- the change itself, which I approved;
- Claude's prediction for the new strip, and its comparison of the new strip with that prediction;
- my verdict in the running game.

## 2026-11-06 — Effect A, r0 (first strip, before any tuning)

**Strip:** `captures/cover_hit_burst/r0/` — frames 10, 12, 15, 20, 30, 50 (fixture).

**Capture log:** `logs/capture_cover_hit_burst_r0.log`. It shows the device NVIDIA RTX 3060 Laptop, and one burst at frame 10 at (600.7, 349.15), rotation −π (pointing back out of the left face).

**My first look** (preview window, 1280 × 720, before any Claude read the strip), in my own words:

> 闪光看得见，正好。砖块主要往左侧飞，也不错。看得清，大小合适。大概一两秒没有了。

(English: The flash is visible and about right. The chips fly mainly to the left, which is good. It is readable and the size is right. It is gone after about one or two seconds.)

**My second look** (preview window, after viewing my own strip, before any Claude reading):

> 看得清。

(English: The chips are readable against the ground.)

Checked against the strip: the burst is gone by frame 50 (1.33 s) and only faint dust is left at frame 30 (0.67 s), so my "one or two seconds" overestimated the duration (brief R2.4).

**In the running game** (main scene, 1280 × 720, NVIDIA RTX 3060, 2026-11-06; Effect A wired in at d2d50fc). I played for a few minutes and shot at cover.

- **Four hits on one wall until it broke** — checked. Every hit was visible.
- **Firing while moving** — checked. The chips read against the ground.
- **Chips go back toward the shooter** — not checked separately.

4	## scale 0.5, turret at TURRET_OFFSET, facing up_right as at the game's spawn, aim_angle -0.6) on

6	## Camera at (640, 360), zoom 1. The smoke sits at TURRET_OFFSET, as tank.gd will place it, and is
7	## driven only through its follow(), the same mapping the tank will call.
8	## Frame numbers are Engine.get_frames_drawn(), which equals the Movie Maker frame number.

11	const STEPS := [[10, 0.5], [60, 0.1], [110, 1.0]]

13	## Fixed seed for this preview's instance only; the effect scene never sets one.
14	@export var fixed_seed := 7

16	@onready var smoke: GPUParticles2D = $YunqiZ/Smoke
17	
18	var _done := {}
19	
20	
21	func _ready() -> void:
22		smoke.use_fixed_seed = true
23		smoke.seed = fixed_seed
24	
25	
26	func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
27		var f := Engine.get_frames_drawn()
28		for step in STEPS:
29			if f >= step[0] and not _done.has(step[0]):
30				_done[step[0]] = true

32				print("preview: frame %d, h %.2f -> emitting %s, amount_ratio %.4f, amount %d" % [f, step[1], smoke.emitting, smoke.amount_ratio, smoke.amount])

content.text:
I read the seven r0 frames at full size and did not crop or enlarge them, so every pixel size below is an eye estimate. I edited nothing and committed nothing.

## What each frame shows

The tank's turret sits at about (600, 382), and the cover is to its right. All the smoke appears within about 25 px of the turret.

| Frame | What it shows | Brief's row |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | Nothing. The tank is clean. | "nothing yet, or one faint wisp" ✓ |
| 25 | Almost nothing; maybe a slight greying on the turret. No column can be seen. | "a short, thin column" ✗ |
| 58 | A soft pale-grey haze, about 30 px across, centred on the turret. Its top is about 25 px above the turret and it covers the turret. | "a full, thin column" ✗: the right density, the wrong shape |
| 90 | The same round haze, a little larger (about 35 px) and denser. There is no gap after frame 60. | density step ✓, "full column" ✗ |
| 112 | Looks the same as 90. Nothing has been cut off. | ✓ |
| 140 | Fainter and paler, but still on the turret, at most a few px higher. | "detached from the tank, thinner, higher" ✗ |
| 165 | Empty. | ✓ |

## Differences from the intent block

1. **Timing.** Start, density step, stop-without-cut and empty-at-165 all hold. The build phase (frame 25) shows no short column. At frame 140 the smoke has not detached, because it has hardly moved.
2. **Scale.** The column should be 2–3 hull lengths tall, about 80–120 px. What the strip shows is about 25–35 px, roughly round, and about the size of the turret. Puffs are born at about 16 px (32 × 0.5), which matches "½ hull width". On paper they end at 64 px (32 × 2.0), about 2 hull widths rather than the brief's 1.5; the soft edge makes the visible part smaller.
3. **Contrast.** The brief plans smoke that is "darker than the ground at its base". After R2.2 we know the ground is dark brown, so #4A4A48 at the base has about the ground's value and cannot be seen. The smoke reads only as a pale, greyer haze, so no dark-to-light change over lif ...[truncated in excerpt: 6190 chars total]
